purpose: 실물 사진의 형태를 대조할 Blender 모델링 참고도. 게임 화면이나 완성 에셋으로 사용하지 않는다.

outputs.prompt: Use the three supplied real LG installation photographs as construction references, not as textures. Create a realistic unbranded outdoor air-conditioner condenser modeling reference sheet, the modest white-painted steel kind on an older Korean villa. Neutral gray studio background, same object shown in front three-quarter, straight front, right service side, and rear three-quarter views, with one close detail of the support bracket and pipe connection. Keep one consistent 80 cm wide, 55 cm high, 30 cm deep metal cabinet across every view. The fan is a real three-bladed dark fan set inside a circular recessed opening, behind a thin light-gray concentric wire safety grille with radial spokes. The fan opening must not be a spiral painted on a closed plate. Thin folded sheet-metal shell, shallow pressed panels, small screws, subtle powder-coat aging without excessive dirt or rust. Include two galvanized triangular wall brackets, rubber isolator feet and anchor plates against a vertical wall plane; an ivory insulated refrigerant line bundle exits the service side, curves gently back up and meets a circular wall sleeve. Keep pipe layout mechanically plausible. Vents show dark heat exchanger fins. No logo, no fictional lettering, no stylization, no exploded or disconnected parts, no extra devices. Even diffuse light revealing physical depth. This is a technical shape and material reference for a game model; never a finished game screenshot.

Use the supplied real MUJI cotton-pile open-toe slipper photographs as strict silhouette and construction references. Create a photorealistic modeling reference sheet of one plain light warm-gray cotton terry house slipper, 27 cm long and 10 cm wide. Show the exact same slipper in top, lateral profile, front three-quarter, rear three-quarter and close macro of the bound edge. The toe opening is genuinely open. The curved soft fabric upper grows from a low small toe opening to a taller broad instep opening; footbed has a shallow padded convex top, thin pale bound edge and darker gray non-slip sole. The heel and toe are broad rounded capsule shapes, not pointed ellipse ends. Keep the real short terry loops at submillimeter scale and natural fabric color separation, slight compression at the heel without dirt stains. Studio diffuse neutral light on a plain gray background, clear soft contact shadows. No feet, people, logos, text or measurement graphics. No geometric sculpture look, no rubber clog, no heavy decorative stitching. Consistent form in every view. This is a practical modeling reference, not a game screenshot.
